task_title: Relax asset-request issue parser to accept rich multi-sentence briefs

plan_review.notes: gpt-5.4 rubber-duck plan review. rounds.details: Independent code-review agent (gpt-5.4) reviewed the parser diff, tests, fixture, and ADR against the seven high-risk invariants (fingerprint stability, brief-capture regex boundaries/ReDoS, length caps, ${{}} guard, type validation, API stability, test quality). No significant issues found.

Clean.
